summary: Plutonian Acquisition Corp. II filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its IPO, partial underwriter over-allotment, and private placement. On April 29, 2026, it sold 10,000,000 units at $10.00 each for $100M gross, and on May 5, 2026, closed 750,000 over-allotment units at $10.00 for $7.5M, plus 7,800 private placement units to the sponsor at $10.00 for $78K. Net proceeds of $108,037,500 ($10.05/unit) were placed in trust. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor named. The SPAC must complete a business combination within 24 months or liquidate. Watch for target announcement and shareholder redemption risk.
